decision: Author authorized recommended H3 engineering and a new measurement; original D6 collection and verdict preserved
warmup: one request per user per size, sequential; all excluded from measured samples
acceptance: all four goal scenarios per configuration must have valid successes, p95 within goal and zero failed requests; 10 users exploratory
load_model: closed loop per user, starts at least cadence_ms apart; requests started before deadline may finish after it; all retained
web_limits: 10 comparisons/user/minute; 2 active comparisons/process; FIFO queue of at most 8, 30 seconds maximum wait; abort removes waiting request; errors retained
hardware_scope: this host only; exact CPU/RAM/Docker recorded before collection

serving_cache.scope: HTTP only, process-local embeddings and window diagnostics
serving_cache.eviction: LRU with absolute TTL; copy on return; state invalidation; training/autocast bypass

analysis_cache.scope: HTTP only, sentence tokens/lemmas from immutable NLP pipeline
analysis_cache.eviction: LRU with absolute TTL; fresh list on return; replacing analyzer invalidates cache; in-place pipeline changes require restart

content: same handwritten numbered development template as original D6; identical source/suspect; no research corpus
comparison_limits: engineering follow-up chosen after original H3; warm repeated texts can hit cache; no conclusion about cold or arbitrary unseen texts; joint queue/cache effect, not component causal attribution; no scientific model changes, original H1/H2/P10 not repeated
rss: core process lifetime peak from HTTP header plus sampled docker stats/cgroup; not attributable per algorithm
retry: no request retries; source/config/image freeze before collection; failures retained
host_guard: do not start below 2 GiB MemAvailable; stop own experiment if MemAvailable below 512 MiB; retain interrupted attempt without declaring complete H3
